findings.title: Shared formatter hardcodes USD even though invoices carry a currency
findings.explanation: `Invoice` in `web/src/api/invoices.ts` has a `currency` field, but `formatCents` always formats as USD. The behavior is unchanged from before, so this isn't a regression. Exporting the helper for reuse makes it easy to show non-USD amounts with a `$` sign in other components. Consider `formatCents(cents, currency = 'USD')`, with a cached `Intl.NumberFormat` per currency. Alternatively, rename it to `formatUsdCents` so the limitation is explicit.

findings.title: Dividing by 100 assumes a two-decimal currency
findings.explanation: `cents / 100` is wrong for currencies with 0 or 3 minor-unit digits, such as JPY or KWD. This only matters if the formatter is later made currency-aware. If so, derive the divisor from `resolvedOptions().maximumFractionDigits`. Otherwise, add a comment saying it is USD-only.
